# CoachLenz

> AI film-analyst OS for coaches. Upload game film, get a coordinator-style breakdown;
> or chart a game live for free. FastAPI + Next.js, Railway Postgres + Cloudflare R2.

## For agents
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent operates CoachLenz (API, MCP server, tools, UATP).
- [mcp.json](mcp.json): MCP server discovery.
- [backend/mcp_server/server-card.json](backend/mcp_server/server-card.json): MCP server card.
- [backend/openapi.json](backend/openapi.json): machine-readable API description.

## Operator agent (read-only)
- Endpoint: `POST /agent/run` (admin), tools at `GET /agent/tools`.
- Tools: credit_costs, margin_check, list_recent_games, retention_gate, conversion_funnel.
- All read-only. A mutating tool requires a human-approval gate (see AGENTS.md).
